name: dejared
description: Java decompiler and JAR analyzer. Decompile classes, search bytecode, and read resources embedded in JAR, WAR, EAR, and AAR archives.

interface.longDescription: Nine tools for navigating JAR, WAR, EAR, AAR, and Spring Boot fat-jars: list packages and resources, search classes and bytecode string literals, read embedded configs, extract class metadata via ASM, and decompile with CFR, Vineflower, or Procyon.
